name: Beefeater Blood Orange
base_ingredient: Cereal and botanical distillate with water, plus sugar
production: Beefeater gin with natural blood orange and orange flavourings; contains sugar
history: 1876 | James Burrough hand-selected oranges from Covent Garden for an orange-flavoured gin
2019 | Blood Orange created, 143 years after the 1876 recipe (approx.)
serve_official: Over ice or with tonic or lemonade; blood orange wheel and a sprig of basil
